headline: Norway Debate Intensifies Over Data Center Power Allocations Near Export Cables
summary: Plans to build massive data centers adjacent to Norwegian hydropower cables provoked political backlash, with critics questioning the domestic industrial efficiency of export-tied clean power usage.
why: Norway is Northern Europe's leading producer of clean hydroelectricity, exporting power to the UK and Western Europe via undersea interconnectors.

impacts.name: Norway
impacts.why: Grid allocation disputes could restrict data center expansion permissions in Nordic regions.
